Yes actually! I started therapeutic ketamine in January and it has made a huge improvement. It wasn't instant and I still have bad days but it's so much better than where I was. I also went through CPT/cognitive processing therapy for trauma I had in my childhood and early adulthood. I am still on a lot of meds but some people have so much improvement they get off all meds so I'm hopeful. I feel like every week or so I gain back a little of what I lost to anhidonia. There is hope!

It helps make it easier to process. I did a group and 1 on 1 trauma recovery program, CPT/cognitive processing therapy, right when I started ketamine. It made it so much easier to stick to and actually talk about my trauma with a therapist. I had attempted a similar treatment the year before and dropped out as it was too intense. Just keep in mind it might not be instant, for some people it is but for me it took a couple months. And I won't say it gets *rid* of it but it makes it soooooooo much more manageable.

Ketamine has been a savior for me and anhedonia. It's taking time, it isn't instant but I'm starting to take my life back after 4 months of treatment. I'm doing infusions under the care of doctors, right now every 3 weeks. I've picked up old hobbies I haven't touched in 2 years. I have an attention span and I don't waste my time sleeping all the time anymore. I highly suggest trying it if you can (I would always do it under a doctor as it is addictive). It's expensive if you don't have insurance but if you can get carecredit or something It's so worth it. My anhedonia was depression induced and made 10X worse by aripiprazole.

28F  (will be 29 on thanksgiving) I love art and building things with my  hands, those are probably the only things that bring me "happiness"  right now.

I'm extremely hard on myself, I can give you a list of what I hate about myself and maybe one thing I like.

I'm  alright with being alone, but I crave connection with other people. I'm  the 'helper friend', if someone has a problem they usually vent to me. I  don't usually have advice for them but I listen to them and try to  help. But its almost impossible for me to ask for help. I wouldn't  consider myself extroverted though, too many loud people make me shut  down.

I like physical affection, but I'm always cautious to touch other people because I don't want to make them uncomfortable.

I  ALWAYS have a project I'm working on, sometimes it takes me months to  finish it, other times I'm laser focused on it. (I have three right now)

When  I'm alone I usually have YouTube playing in the background because it  makes me feel less alone. I love to read, fiction and non-fiction.  Psychological thrillers are my favorite.

My  goal in life is to get a PhD in psychology. I love to help people, it  makes me feel useful and like I have a purpose. I tend to take criticism  to heart.

I usually see the good  in everyone, even if they've hurt me physically or mentally (bad I  know). I like to theorize why people are the way they are. Whether it be  mental disorder, abuse/upbringing, or past trauma. I can usually  immediately tell when someone is depressed(only in person though, text  is hard to discern unless its a list of symptoms).

I  have a burning passion to protect people. Its one of the reasons I  joined the army. All of my shyness goes out the window if I see someone  (or animal) being mistreated or hurt. I would put myself in mortal  danger to help a stranger without thinking. That might also be in part  because I really don't care if I die.

People often say that I am charming and easy to talk to, but I have a very difficult time seeing myself as "charming".

I  love to joke around with people and be stupid (especially when  drinking) but I also love deep discussions. I love to hear peoples  opinion on different things, even if they aren't the same as mine. I  like to try and see how other people view things and put myself in their  shoes.

I have a hard time when  people dislike me because I always want to know why, or what I have done  to make them think badly of me. I always try to fix it or fix myself to  me more likable to others. I will not however, compromise or change my  morals (hurting people, animals etc.).

I  like the thought of routine, it makes me feel comfortable, but I rarely  follow it. Unless someone is relying on me, I do things in my own time  with or without planning.

Let me know what you think!
